title: Learning free energy across a differentiable temperature range by deep generative modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.28810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Free energy governs the directionality, stability, and temperature sensitivity of physical, chemical, and biological transformations. Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an extensive set of thermodynamic states. Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization. TD-FEP thereby unifies one-shot state generation and free energy calculation across a continuous temperature range. We validated TD-FEP across a broad range of applications, including isolated molecules, periodic materials, and chemical reactions.

translated_title: 基于深度生成建模学习可微温度范围内的自由能
translated_abstract: 自由能决定了物理、化学和生物转变的方向性、稳定性和温度敏感性。传统的自由能计算方法，如热力学积分和自由能微扰，通常必须在各个单独的温度下进行，并且受到对大量热力学状态进行采样所需的高成本的限制。在此，我们提出了可学习的可微温度自由能微扰方法（TD-FEP），这是一个深度生成框架，通过无数据的、基于能量的优化，学习参考系统与目标系统之间以温度为条件的可逆映射。由此，TD-FEP 将一次性状态生成与连续温度范围内的自由能计算统一起来。我们在广泛的应用场景中验证了 TD-FEP，包括孤立分子、周期性材料和化学反应。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种深度生成框架 TD-FEP，通过学习温度条件下的可逆映射，实现了在连续可微温度范围内统一进行一次性状态生成与自由能计算，并已在分子、材料和化学反应等场景中得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TD-FEP, a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned invertible mapping between systems, unifying one-shot state generation and free energy calculation across a continuous differentiable temperature range, validated on molecules, materials, and chemical reactions.
